name: Moonshot Kimi Hosted Agents sandbox

modes.label: Hosted Agents 1C/1G sandbox
modes.note: Native CNY public list/reference quote; rates converted using fx.json. Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: Unknown quotas are not confirmed unlimited.

caveats: 4/8 machine unavailable in published shape table; 50-way concurrency unknown.
Tax basis not stated; do not assume CNY prices include 6% VAT.
Pause of conversation is not proof of RAM/process snapshot persistence.
1 core may not equal dedicated physical core.
Unknowns remain null, not free; generic infrastructure modes are opt-in alt.
Worked example assumes resources are released between active windows unless a retained-instance scenario is explicitly discussed.
VAT basis: Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.
Residency: China domestic enterprise-verified customers only, sales-assisted beta. Exact datacenter not published.

Per-exec limits: shell/ipython single execution timeout 4 min, single tool call total timeout 5 min (defaults). Base image Debian 12. Each session has its own sandbox. Sandbox billed 'by running duration' -- whether an idle session (status idle, awaiting input) keeps a billed sandbox is not stated.

fleet.verification: Hosted Agents beta only open to domestically enterprise-verified users; obtain enterprise verification and contact sales for testing support before API-key use. Exact required business documents/approval delay not stated.
fleet.notes: Not an unrestricted new individual self-serve fleet. Public enterprise-beta quickstart gives no numeric account sandbox/vCPU/GPU quota. Model API token tiers must not be reused as sandbox-instance limits.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: 实例本地文件可能在实例回收后丢失；挂载到会话的工作区、会话文件和 [记忆库](/docs/hosted-agents/memory) 可以跨实例保存，但采用异步写回，实例退出前尚未完成同步的最新写入仍可能丢失。
snapshot_auto.note: Instances are recycled/rebuilt transparently; only the /mnt/agents workspace is async-synced and remounted on a new instance (persistent workspace, not a machine snapshot). Instance-local files and processes are not preserved. Quickstart says the service stores 'conversation history, sandbox state and outputs' server-side and sessions 'can be paused and resumed', but the sandbox pages describe that as workspace file sync.

snapshot_on_demand.note: No snapshot/checkpoint/fork endpoint in the full Hosted Agents OpenAPI (2026-09-01-beta) or docs. Closest: environments (versioned build configs: packages + setup_script) that new sessions boot from, save_artifact for immutable output versions, and versioned memory stores.

harness_api.quote: 会话用于运行智能体。创建会话后，通过事件接口发送 `user.message` 来提交输入。
harness_api.note: Harness = Kimi's own hosted agent (Claude-Managed-Agents-style API): POST /v1/sessions, POST /v1/sessions/{id}/events (user.message, user.interrupt), SSE event stream with resume cursor (agent.message/agent.delta/agent.tool_use...), list/get/archive sessions, multi-agent threads, cron triggers. Does not run Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode; hakimi CLI/skill only helps those tools create Kimi hosted agents.

egress_allowlist.quote: `limited` | **推荐用于生产环境**。仅允许访问指定主机，也可以按需允许 MCP server 和公共包注册表
egress_allowlist.note: Per environment config.networking: 'unrestricted' (default, still blocks a security blacklist / cloud metadata) or 'limited' with allowed_hosts (exact or *.wildcard hostnames, optional port, default 80/443; IPs/CIDRs allowed for direct TCP on any port; max 128), allow_mcp_servers, allow_package_managers. Optional forwarding through your own HTTPS proxy (basic or mTLS auth from vault; route_all added 2026-09-03). Applies to sandbox processes, not platform tools (web search/fetch).

egress_http_rules.quote: 条目不要包含 URL scheme（如 `https://`）或路径
egress_http_rules.note: Allowlist is host/IP(+port) only; no method/path/header rules. Vault credentials can be restricted to hosts and to header vs body substitution, which is not a traffic rule. DIY via route_all to your own proxy.

secret_proxy.quote: 对于 `environment_variable`，沙箱中的环境变量是占位符，不是真实密钥。这种类型的凭据适合将凭据放入出站请求，不适合在本地校验真实密钥，或使用真实密钥计算请求签名。
secret_proxy.note: Vault credentials: environment_variable type (placeholder env var; platform egress proxy substitutes the real value in headers and/or body only for the credential's allowed_hosts), plus static_bearer / mcp_oauth (with refresh) for MCP servers. tools.md: '凭据注入只覆盖经平台出口代理的 HTTP/HTTPS 流量（端口 80/443）' so no DB/SSH/git-over-SSH coverage. Max 20 active credentials per vault, 16 vaults per session, bound at session creation only.

volume_attach.quote: `/mnt/agents/memories/<name>/` | 绑定的 [记忆库](/docs/hosted-agents/memory)（Memory Store），每个记忆库一个目录 | 绑定时可选 `read_only` / `read_write`
volume_attach.note: Memory Stores: project-level persistent, versioned file collections mounted into sessions (bound only at session creation). A file store, not block storage; async write-back. Uploaded files mount read-only at /mnt/agents/upload/; org file storage quota 10 GiB by default.

volume_shared.quote: 通过会话挂载路径和文件工具写入时，不经过 API 的 `content_sha256` 并发校验，并发写入可能互相覆盖。
volume_shared.note: Same memory store can be bound read_write (or read_only) by multiple sessions; sandbox-reference: other sessions bound to the same store can see the changes. Concurrent writes via mount may overwrite each other (async sync, not a POSIX shared FS). Session workspaces themselves are never shared.

image_oci.quote: 目前 config.type 仅支持 "cloud"。packages、networking 和 setup_script 都是可选配置
image_oci.note: Environments only extend a fixed Debian-12-based sandbox image via package managers (apt/pip/npm/go/cargo) and a setup_script; there is no option to boot from a customer-supplied Docker/OCI image.

docker_inside.quote: 沙箱基于 Debian 12（bookworm）镜像构建，预装常用的语言运行时、系统工具，以及文档和数据处理软件。
docker_inside.note: Docker/containers are not among the preinstalled tools, and there is no privileged/nested-container option in the environment config; not offered.

nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. The sandbox is a lightweight, per-session code-exec environment for the agent's shell/ipython tools; no /dev/kvm or VM-in-sandbox capability is documented.

desktop.quote: 浏览器 | Chromium（无头模式，供 PDF 渲染、图表截图等工具链使用）
desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. The only browser present is headless Chromium used internally by document/rendering tools; there is no VNC/RDP/streamed graphical desktop.

computer_use.quote: 搜索 | web_search | 联网搜索 ... web_open_url | 打开指定 URL 并读取网页内容
computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Built-in tools are file/shell/ipython/web_search/web_open_url/save_artifact; there is no screenshot+click 'computer use' API driving a GUI.

anti_bot.quote: 搜索 | web_open_url | 打开指定 URL 并读取网页内容
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. web_search/web_open_url are simple content-fetch tools; no stealth/fingerprinting evasion against bot detection is documented.

captcha_solving.quote: 内置工具集由平台默认提供。
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. No CAPTCHA-solving tool or capability appears anywhere in the built-in toolset docs.

egress_ip_type.quote: unrestricted | 默认。允许访问公网，但仍会拦截通用安全黑名单中的地址
egress_ip_type.note: Sandbox egress is straight platform-cloud internet access (optionally restricted to an allowlist, or routed through a customer-supplied proxy); no residential/mobile IP product is offered.

ssh.quote: 代码 | shell | 在云沙箱中执行 Shell 命令
ssh.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. All access to the sandbox is mediated by the platform's shell/ipython/file tools and the Sessions/Events API; no SSH endpoint is documented.

snapshot.quote: No snapshot/checkpoint/fork endpoint in the full Hosted Agents OpenAPI (2026-09-01-beta) or docs.
snapshot.note: Confirmed in card's own feature_evidence (snapshot_auto=false, snapshot_on_demand=false). Only the workspace directory is async file-synced across instance rebuilds; no memory/process snapshot exists.

fork.quote: No snapshot/checkpoint/fork endpoint in the full Hosted Agents OpenAPI.

fork_running.quote: No snapshot/checkpoint/fork endpoint in the full Hosted Agents OpenAPI.
fork_running.note: No fork capability at all, so forking a running machine is not possible.

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: No snapshot/checkpoint/fork endpoint in the full Hosted Agents OpenAPI.
memory_snapshot_fork.note: No fork or memory-snapshot capability exists.

wake_on_request.quote: 实例重建后，平台会自动把后续工具调用落到新实例上，客户端不需要额外处理。
wake_on_request.note: When a session's instance has been recycled, the next tool call/message transparently triggers a fresh instance with the synced workspace remounted; no explicit 'wake' API call is needed by the caller.

auto_stop_idle.quote: 实例本地文件可能在实例回收后丢失
auto_stop_idle.note: Docs describe instances being 'recycled' (回收) automatically, implying idle sandbox instances are stopped/reclaimed by the platform rather than kept running indefinitely; exact idle threshold not published.

live_resize.quote: 云沙箱 | 1 核 CPU / 1 GB 内存 | ¥0.072 / 小时
live_resize.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Only a single fixed 1 vCPU / 1 GiB shape is published; no API to resize a running sandbox's CPU/RAM.

own_agent_api.quote: 运行在 Kimi 开放平台基础设施上的预构建、可配置的智能体托管服务 ... 通过事件接口发送 user.message 来提交输入
own_agent_api.note: The Sessions/Events API drives Kimi's own hosted task agent (with built-in web_search/web_open_url/shell/ipython/save_artifact tools, e.g. the official PPT and financial-research agents), not a user-supplied coding harness like Claude Code/Codex.

mcp_server.quote: 托管智能体原生支持接入远程 MCP 服务：你在智能体上声明服务地址，平台在会话运行时自动建立连接
mcp_server.note: Kimi is an MCP *client* (it connects to remote MCP servers you declare) — it does not ship its own MCP server for controlling its sandboxes; the CLI tool for this purpose (hakimi) is a plain CLI, not an MCP server.

public_ipv4.quote: 沙箱进程的出站网络访问由所属执行环境的 networking 配置决定。
public_ipv4.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Docs discuss only outbound (egress) network policy for the sandbox; there is no mention of a public IPv4 address assigned to a sandbox for inbound reachability.

inbound_https.quote: 该配置只影响沙箱内进程，不影响平台层工具，例如 Web Search 和 Fetch。
inbound_https.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. The sandbox is reached only through the platform's own Sessions/Events/Files APIs; there is no documented way to expose an HTTPS URL to a port running inside the sandbox.

ingress_rules.quote: networking 控制沙箱进程的出站网络访问，不影响平台层工具自身的网络访问。
ingress_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. The only documented network controls (networking.type / allowed_hosts) govern outbound (egress) traffic; there is no inbound exposure to the sandbox to apply ingress rules to.

static_egress_ip.quote: 两种模式都可以配置 proxy，把指定的出站流量经自有代理转发
static_egress_ip.note: Default egress is via shared platform cloud infrastructure with no fixed outbound IP documented; a fixed egress IP is only achievable by routing traffic through your own proxy, which is a customer-supplied workaround, not a provider feature.

gpu.quote: 云沙箱 | 1 核 CPU / 1 GB 内存 | ¥0.072 / 小时
gpu.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Only a single fixed CPU-only 1 vCPU/1 GiB sandbox shape is published; no GPU sandbox option exists.

windows.quote: 沙箱基于 Debian 12（bookworm）镜像构建
windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. The sandbox is a Linux (Debian 12) image only.

macos.quote: 沙箱基于 Debian 12（bookworm）镜像构建
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Linux-only cloud sandbox; no macOS machine option.

self_host.quote: 运行在 Kimi 开放平台基础设施上的预构建、可配置的智能体托管服务
self_host.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Hosted Agents runs only on Kimi's own platform infrastructure; there is no self-hosted/on-prem deployment option documented.

byoc.quote: 运行在 Kimi 开放平台基础设施上的预构建、可配置的智能体托管服务
byoc.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. No option to deploy the managed service into a customer's own cloud account is documented.

open_source.quote: Kimi 托管智能体（Beta 版）正式开启测试，在模型推理 API 之上封装 Kimi Durable Harness
open_source.note: Hosted Agents is a proprietary hosted service (Kimi's own 'Durable Harness'); no OSI-licensed open-source release of the sandbox/harness platform is documented.

arm64.quote: 沙箱基于 Debian 12（bookworm）镜像构建，预装常用的语言运行时、系统工具，以及文档和数据处理软件。
arm64.note: not offered: the product exposes exactly one fixed sandbox size (1 vCPU/1GB, per pricing page) with a single Debian 12 image and no CPU-architecture selector anywhere in the environments/sandbox-reference docs or the sessions/environments OpenAPI schema; no ARM option is mentioned.

soc2.quote: 了解 Kimi 开放平台的账号、API 使用、计费、数据与合规规则及双方权利义务。
soc2.note: not offered: the platform's terms of service, org-management/security docs (IP allowlist, org verification) and hosted-agents docs contain no mention of SOC 2 or any third-party security attestation.

hipaa.quote: Beta 版当前仅针对国内企业认证用户开放，扫描下方二维码，联系销售获取测试支持。
hipaa.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Hosted Agents beta is restricted to China-domestic enterprise-verified customers via sales; no BAA, HIPAA eligibility, or US healthcare compliance program is mentioned anywhere in the docs or terms of service.

sso.quote: 个人认证和企业认证用户均可使用该能力；配置并保存后，仅白名单内的 IP 可以访问当前组织下的 API
sso.note: not offered: org/account management docs describe phone-number registration, personal/enterprise identity verification, member roles, and an IP allowlist as the org security controls. No SAML/OIDC single sign-on is mentioned anywhere in the console/org-management or hosted-agents docs.

eu_data_residency.quote: Beta 版当前仅针对国内企业认证用户开放，扫描下方二维码，联系销售获取测试支持。
eu_data_residency.note: Hosted Agents beta is sales-gated and restricted to domestically (China) enterprise-verified customers only; API base is api.moonshot.cn. No region selection, EU datacenter, or data-residency option is mentioned anywhere in quickstart, pricing, sandbox-reference, or environments docs -- the product is a China-only offering with no EU presence, so eu_data_residency=false is correct.
